decisions.reason: Minimum quantity lubrication fits the firm's coolant and metalworking fluid portfolio and costs little to keep listed, and with no evidence since 2019 its value is still uncertain, so the option stays open.
Hydrocyclone coolant filters are a standard, low-maintenance part of a coolant filtration range, and with no negative signal the cheap option of keeping it outweighs dropping it.
Gravity band filters are a core, widely demanded filtration product that complements the other filters, so keeping it costs little and preserves its upside.
